headword: {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}

definitions.gloss: surcharge; premium; extra fee added to a base price
definitions.explanation: An additional amount added to the regular fee under specific conditions — late-night hours, holidays, oversized or overweight items, overtime work, peak seasons, and the like. Appears on taxi receipts, delivery invoices, utility bills, and airline tickets.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}は{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}がかかる。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}の{予約|よやく}には{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}が{発生|はっせい}します。
examples.english: A surcharge applies to reservations during consecutive holidays.

examples.japanese: {大型|おおがた}の{荷物|にもつ}を{送|おく}る{場合|ばあい}、{通常|つうじょう}の{料金|りょうきん}に{加|くわ}えて{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}が{請求|せいきゅう}されます。
examples.english: When shipping oversized luggage, a surcharge is charged in addition to the regular fee.

notes:
Formed from {割増|わりまし} ('adding on a percentage, premium') + {料金|りょうきん} ('fee, charge'). Most commonly seen on receipts, fare tables, and terms of service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}がかかる: a surcharge applies
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}が{発生|はっせい}する: a surcharge is incurred
- {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}を{支払|しはら}う: to pay a surcharge
- {深夜|しんや}{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}: late-night surcharge
- {休日|きゅうじつ}{割増料金|わりましりょうきん}: holiday surcharge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追加料金|ついかりょうきん}: additional fee — for any extra fee, whether percentage-based or flat; broader than {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee, commission — a fee for providing a service (e.g., bank transfer fee)
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}: base fee — the standard rate before surcharges
- {深夜料金|しんやりょうきん}: late-night rate — a specific kind of {割増料金|わりましりょうきん}

USAGE:
Taxi fares in Japan famously include a 20% {深夜|しんや}{割増料金|わりましりょうきん} between roughly 10 p.m. and 5 a.m., which is a familiar concept to anyone who takes late-night taxis.
